as_told.title: SAR scan of the Great Pyramid showing the Grand Gallery and the big void

plain: A researcher named Filippo says that his team scanned the Great Pyramid at Giza in Egypt using SAR, a radar method that builds images from radar echoes, during work he dates to about 2018 to 2020. He says they picked up the Grand Gallery, the pyramid's long inner passage, and also what is called the Big Void, a large hidden space inside the pyramid, lying east to west, and he stresses that these were real readings, not simulated ones. He tells it, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels and crediting a colleague named Corrado, because if true it would mean radar can see hidden structures inside the pyramids.
